title: Boy with Playground Basketball, Cuffed Jeans - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vertical snapshot capturing a young boy posing with a basketball or rubber playground ball held in both hands outdoors. He wears a dark crewneck sweater, wide-cuffed blue jeans rolled up at the ankles, and dark shoes. Behind him is a tree-lined residential setting with a utility pole, an overhead canopy of foliage, and a house nestled on a hill. A pronounced horizontal crease runs across the lower portion of the photographic print.
